messages:
microcosm-dev: Hey team — onboarding with Redwood SDK (electron client). Hitting a flood of 429s right after first few users join. No heavy traffic, just dev testing.

microcosm-dev: Quick log dump:
```
2026-03-01T14:03:12.123Z GET /v1/preflight 200 10ms
2026-03-01T14:03:12.234Z POST /v1/handshake 401 15ms x-client-fp=abc123
2026-03-01T14:03:12.345Z POST /v1/handshake 429 8ms
2026-03-01T14:03:12.400Z POST /v1/handshake 429 6ms
```
Not sure why 401 then 429s pile up. Tokens are ephemeral TTL=60s.

alex_cs: thx for the logs. Which SDK version and auth flow? Is the app creating multiple preflight/handshake calls in parallel on coldstart?

microcosm-dev: Using @redwood/sdk-js v0.9.2, ephemeral flow via our auth service. On cold open we spawn 8 renderer threads that each call `init()` concurrently.

nidhi_se: that concurrency + short TTL is a classic fanout preflight. Each renderer races to refresh token -> many preflight handshakes -> transient 401s then 429 when rate limiter kicks in. Can you try single-sourced token fetch or splay init?

sam_se: quick mitigation: set SDK option `prefetchConcurrency: 2` and add jitter to your ephemeral refresh. Example:
```
Redwood.init({
  preflightConcurrency: 2,
  preflightSplayMs: 300 + Math.random() * 700
});
```
Also bump ephemeral TTL on the server to 120s while onboarding to reduce refresh frequency.

microcosm-dev: copied that. Any server-side rate limits you can relax temporarily? We need this to be stable for next 24h demo.

infra-bot: @microcosm-dev — temporary quota bump applied: preflight QPS increased to 40 for account microcosm-inc until 2026-03-02T14:00:00Z. Monitor and revert if abnormal. :white_check_mark:

nidhi_se: also add a small circuit-breaker on client for 429s: exponential backoff with cap 2s. That prevents tight retry loops.

microcosm-dev: implemented splay + concurrency=2 + backoff. Demo run looks cleaner — only occasional 429s during stress, previously it was constant. Thanks.

alex_cs: great. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement session to walk through best-practices (single-source token, keepalive, preflight splay). Drop availability?

microcosm-dev: available tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PST. Also can share our init code for review.

sam_se: follow-up action items: 1) Microcosm to share init snippet, 2) Redwood to send preflight best-practices doc and recommend server TTL change, 3) infra will monitor QPS and auto-revert bump.

microcosm-dev: thanks all — will upload snippet and confirm demo stability. :thumbsup:
